prompt: Create an ultra-cinematic dark fantasy action illustration in a wide 16:9 frame, like a high-budget game key visual. Show exactly 4 humanoid figures in a chaotic aerial battle: 1 central silver-haired male warrior lunging toward the viewer with one arm outstretched, wearing ornate black-and-silver armor with gold details, intense focused expression, long hair blown upward by force; 1 pale red-haired wounded figure on the left reclining or falling backward in flowing white fabric, face tilted upward, scratched and bloodied; 1 enormous pale white-haired face in extreme close-up on the right edge, partially cropped, eyes shadowed, with blood marks and strands of hair filling the frame; and 1 small distant fiery red-haired fighter near the upper center, surrounded by branching golden lightning. The scene should feel like a clash of immortal warriors in a storm of fire, lightning, and wind. Use silver-white for the central warrior, ornate black-and-silver fantasy armor with gold accents, and golden lightning and orange fire. Compose with extreme dynamic perspective, motion blur, swirling hair and cloth, embers, smoke, sparks, shattered debris, glowing highlights, and warm firelight against cool gray shadows. Make the image painterly yet hyper-detailed, dramatic, emotional, and epic, with no text, no logos, no UI, and no watermark.
